scenes.title: Every pull request, in one queue.
scenes.narration: [enthusiasm] Red Pen puts every pull request in one queue, [natural pace] with what needs you at the top. New comments and failing checks are flagged, and you can triage without leaving the keyboard.

scenes.title: Your forges in. Your queue out.
scenes.narration: Red Pen checks your forges every three minutes and keeps a local copy. From that copy come your Review Queue and Your Pulls, the count in the menu bar, hooks that run your own programs, and an agent that reads the same data over MCP.

scenes.title: Read the change, not the noise.
bullets: Notes in ink, right on the line
A diagram of how it fits
An agent tour of the risky parts
scenes.narration: Open the changes and read them properly. Leave notes in ink right on the line, see a diagram of how the change fits together, and let an agent walk you through the risky parts.
Pick a pull request, open its changes, and move through the diff. Jump to a file and keep reading.

scenes.title: Review faster. Miss less.
scenes.narration: Red Pen is local, fast and private, and it works with GitHub and Forgejo. [bold] Review faster, and miss less.
